// diagnostic

E1104

`#Layout(c)` struct contains a field whose type is growable (`[T]`, `Map`, or `String`).

What

`#Layout(c)` struct contains a field whose type is growable (`[T]`, `Map`, or `String`).

Why

Growable Rust heap types don't have a stable C layout — the raw data pointer and length live at unpredictable offsets.

Fix

use a fixed-size array `[T#N]` instead, or remove `#Layout(c)` if C interop is not required.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1104: tests/ui/layout_c_growable_field.stderr.

Error [E1104]: `#Layout(c)` struct `Packet` has a growable field `payload` ([Int])
  --> tests/ui/layout_c_growable_field.jet:2:1
    |
  2 | #Layout(c)
    | ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: growable types (`[T]`, `Map`, `String`) don't have a stable C layout
 Fix: use a fixed-size array `[T#N]` instead, or remove `#Layout(c)`
